project.name: Representative NC Civil Rights Matter
project.objective: Maintain claim-by-claim, defendant-by-defendant litigation research with verified authority and evidence mapping.
definition_of_done: Approved claim architecture, defendant/capacity map, and source model are recorded.
constraints: Primary authority must support consequential legal propositions

architecture.summary: Separate defendants, capacities, claims, threshold defenses, evidence, remedies, and procedural posture.
boundaries: Material changes to forum, defendant set, capacity theory, or controlling claim theory require a new architecture decision
dependencies: Claim and defense matrices depend on source baseline

sources: Primary federal and North Carolina authority
risks: Threshold defenses may dispose of otherwise plausible claims

routing.policy: Use low-cost tiers for bounded evidence organization and strong independent review for high-stakes claim analysis.

domain.extension_status: Detailed civil-rights fields are owned by issue #11
